thread:
Maya - Growth: Ok team — kicking off the sprout launch signalboard. Goal: 1k signups, 20% activation (first 3 prompts). Experiment surface: launch posts, a short webinar, 3 free-credit variants, onboarding prompt templates, and inbound routing. Drafts due Thu, send Mon.
Alex - PM: Love it. For credits — do we want token bands (1k / 3k / 10k) or nicer round tiers (1000/2500/7500)? Recommend simple numbers. Canary to 10% first.
Jordan - Content: I can draft social + webinar CTAs. Thinking 3 creative angles: fast time-to-value, cost control, and plug-and-play prompt packs. Will prepare 3 short hooks + 2 subject lines each.
Lee - Demand Gen: Routing plan: high-intent (webinar signups, claim-credit clicks) -> 'seed-nurture' + 1:1 option. Low-intent -> 5-email drip. Need a small rule to tag credit variant on signup. Draft rule:
```json
{
  "if": "source == 'webinar' || utm_campaign == 'sprout-demo'",
  "route_to": "seed-nurture",
  "credit_offer": "2500"
}
```
Priya - Analytics: Baselines + tracking: webinar CTR target 12-20%, signup->activation baseline 18%. Events to instrument: `signup`, `credit_claimed`, `first_prompt`, `first_successful_completion`. Dashboard: cohort by `credit_variant`. Hypothesis: middle variant + prompt templates -> biggest activation lift.
Maya - Growth: Also want to test prompt-template placement inside onboarding vs after first use. Jordan — can you create 3 template packs: "summarize", "rework", "code helper" with 3 examples each?
Jordan - Content: Yep. Will push to /docs/promptpacks and link the sample prompts in the onboarding flow. I'll keep them very short (1-2 lines) for quick selection.
Alex - PM: Rollout plan: canary 10% of new signups (hosted), monitor activation uplift and cost-per-activation. Gate decisions: require >7pp activation lift and cost-per-activation < threshold. If fail, fallback to lowest-credit + email nudges.
Lee - Demand Gen: Webinar plan: 30-min format: 10m product, 10m prompt clinic, 10m live Qs. Proposed date: Wed next week 10am PT. Speakers: Maya + Eng rep. I'll spin up landing + registration. Primary CTA: 'Claim 2500 starter credits'. Secondary CTA: 'Join live prompt clinic'.
ops-bot: webinar page created -> https://events.redwood.example/sprout-demo
Priya - Analytics: Quick cohort SQL for tracking: `SELECT user_id FROM signups WHERE utm_source='sprout' AND created_at >= '2026-03-20'` — will add these to the dashboard.
Maya - Growth: Action items: Jordan draft copy by Wed EOD; Priya dashboard & instrumentation by Wed noon; Lee create landing + registration today; Alex set canary in Redwood Console; @ops-bot set reminder in 48h. :spiral_calendar: 
ops-bot: reminder set for 48h
Jordan - Content: Quick q — for social CTAs, do we push 'claim 2500 credits' (direct) or 'reserve a spot' (soft)? My bias is direct for PLG funnel.
Lee - Demand Gen: Agreed on direct. Use 'claim' as primary, 'join live' secondary. We'll A/B the header copy.
Alex - PM: We'll tag users with property `credit_variant` at signup. Priya, can you ensure it's in the analytics table and included in daily drip segmentation?
Priya - Analytics: Done. Added `credit_variant` column to the signup view and scheduled daily cohort jobs. Will share dashboard link once data flows.
Maya - Growth: Cool. Quick sync tomorrow 11am PT to review hooks and landing. Small note: keep emails short and include 2 sample prompts in the first email to increase immediate usage. :rocket:
